# Cold War Project: flags of the countries on the map at 1946.1.1.
# Generated by gen_flags.py (kept outside the mod); change the script's table and rerun rather than editing by hand.
# The file name sorts after zz_vanilla_flag_definitions.txt on purpose: it REPLACEs a list that file also replaces (JAP).
# Priorities: DEFAULT (zz_vanilla) gives a random communist flag at 1000 and anarchy at 2000.
#   900  start flag; loses to the communist flag if the country turns communist later
#   950  Italy: republican tricolour from 2 June 1946
#   1100 the tag's own vanilla communist flag, where vanilla has one
#   1500 start flag of countries that begin with communist (council republic) laws
#   1600 flag after leaving subject status (occupied Germany, Korea, selected colonies)
# Art: common/coat_of_arms/coat_of_arms/cwp_1946_countries.txt (cwp_ keys), otherwise vanilla keys.

REPLACE:ABU = {	# Trucial States: trucial flag
	flag_definition = {
		coa = ABU
		subject_canton = ABU
		priority = 900
	}
}
